arguments.command:
python -c "
import more_itertools as mi

# Test various edge cases
print('Empty:', list(mi.stagger([])))
print('Single:', list(mi.stagger([1])))
print('Two:', list(mi.stagger([1, 2])))
print('Offsets empty:', list(mi.stagger([1, 2], offsets=())))
print('Offset (0,):', list(mi.stagger([1, 2], offsets=(0,))))
print('Negative offset:', list(mi.stagger([1, 2, 3], offsets=(-2, -1, 0), fillvalue='X')))
print('Longest negative:', list(mi.stagger([1, 2, 3], offsets=(-2, -1, 0), fillvalue='X', longest=True)))

# Try with generator
def gen():
    yield 1
    yield 2
    yield 3
print('Generator:', list(mi.stagger(gen())))
"
